question.wording: Does the taxpayer elect the de minimis safe harbor for tangible property for 2025 (Regulations section 1.263(a)-1(f))?

options.label: Yes — elected; each capitalized cost of $2,500 or less is an other expense
No — not elected; every capitalized cost is depreciated

citation.wording: If you don’t have an applicable financial statement, you may use the de minimis safe harbor to deduct amounts paid for tangible property up to $2,500 per item or invoice.
